body.intent: Fix A run's agent session that ends its turn while its own background shell runs (e.g. scoped tests started with run_in_background) sits idle at its prompt and is never flagged: no inbox stalled item and no nudge, so the run waits indefinitely. Seen 2026-11-05: run 01M6N133 fixer session 9130a4fa sat at its prompt about an hour after a recap ('Next, once the scoped daemon tests pass, I'll commit...') with 1 shell open, until the orchestrator sent rhiza session message. Stall detection should treat an idle prompt with no tool call for N minutes as stalled even when a background shell exists, and nudge it to check the shell's result.
